title: Criminal enterprises in Southeast Asian scam hubs are recruiting "AI face models" to facilitate crypto and romance scams; some demand 100+ video calls per day (Matt Burgess/Wired)
summary: Matt Burgess / Wired: Criminal enterprises in Southeast Asian scam hubs are recruiting “AI face models” to facilitate crypto and romance scams; some demand 100+ video calls per day — Dozens of Telegram channels reviewed by WIRED include job listings for “AI face models.”
contentText:
Matt Burgess / Wired :

Criminal enterprises in Southeast Asian scam hubs are recruiting “AI face models” to facilitate crypto and romance scams; some demand 100+ video calls per day   —  Dozens of Telegram channels reviewed by WIRED include job listings for “AI face models.”
